ruleDefinitions.name: MMC Spawning Windows Shell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a Windows command line executable started from MMC

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\BITSADMIN.*")))
